answer: Cap paid submissions at 40 per identity per epoch, checked by a rotating pool of 12 auditors drawn fresh each epoch, so no clique grades its own kin. Each identity posts 80 POA locked 45 days, 100% slashed on a proven duplicate, and a second duplicate freezes the whole funder cluster. Like sediment settling on a mesa, trust accrues only from clean epochs; a fake copying the pigment of real work still pays the same bond, and a zephyr of cheap clones hits the cap and earns nothing more. 1,000 fakes cost 80,000 POA locked.
